headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins fell to the Cleveland Guardians 2-5, despite Ryan Jeffers' home run and RBI. The Los Angeles Dodgers edged the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Justin Wrobleski earning the win. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays 12-2, led by Nick Fortes' 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries. Stephen Kolek, a right-handed pitcher for the Kansas City Royals, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right flexor strain. Bobby Witt Jr., also of the Royals, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with low back tightness. Other notable injuries include Drey Jameson's right hip inflammation with the Arizona Diamondbacks and Jack Flaherty's right flexor inflammation with the Detroit Tigers.

The Colorado Rockies made a significant roster move, trading RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers in exchange for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Kansas City Royals traded RF Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 2-5 decision to the Cleveland Guardians, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Guardians' pitching staff. Ryan Jeffers led the Twins at the plate with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Edge Phillies in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers took down the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Justin Wrobleski earning the win.

top_news.title: **Rays Cruise Past Blue Jays 12-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory. Nick Fortes led the offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Braves 8-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured an 8-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves, led by a dominant performance from their offense. Manny Machado led the charge with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Roster Update: Stephen Kolek Moves to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-handed pitcher Stephen Kolek has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right flexor strain.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers on July 20, 2026, in exchange for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.
